operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no distance or statistical-nearest-neighbor primitive; normalization and addition do not compute pairwise distances.
The catalog represents data partitioning and layout changes, while cKDTree construction creates a spatial indexing data structure.
Graph convolution propagates messages over an explicit graph and is distinct from feature projection and self-attention.
The catalog has data selection, projection, and lookup primitives, but none represents rule-based dispatch of graph steps to expert roles.
